title: 第25章 一阶极品巅峰第26章 夜测灵根
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
陈凡从地上爬起来，擦掉嘴角的血迹，脸上的惊恐被冷峻代替。
他将白骨令牌收入储物袋，随后闭上双眼，心神沉入气海，开始在林家老祖那杂乱的记忆碎片中搜寻有关此人的线索。
百息之后，陈凡睁开眼，眼中闪过一抹恍然。
“临泉郡老鬼。”
林家老祖的记忆碎片里，曾有一份关于云国散修高手的隐秘玉简，其中便详细记载过此人。
此人是云国修仙界中出了名的万事通，专做高阶散修之间的大宗物资中介、功法倒卖以及高级情报交易。
此人无门无派，但人脉极广，手段极多。
最核心的信息是，三十年前，这老鬼似乎因为在某处上古遗迹中盗取了一件不得了的古物，曾与人界某位神秘的元婴期大修士有过节，被一路追杀。
为了躲避仇家，他这才隐藏了容貌和修仙痕迹，逃难到这临泉与青阳交界的混乱之地。
不过，此人虽然看似贪婪、邋遢，但在这边界地带的黑市中信誉极佳，专讲利益与承诺，向来不问雇主的出身。
“临泉郡鬼市，万事通……元婴修士的仇家。”
陈凡整理完这些信息，心中大定。
老鬼今天虽然看破了他的一丝端倪，但对方留下了白骨令牌，显然是看中了他的炼器手段，想要将他发展成未来鬼市的长期合作伙伴。
这对于如今在青阳郡寸步难行的陈凡来说，无异于在临泉郡那边提前打下了一颗极为重要的情报钉子。
接下来的数日，由于老鬼的这桩生意，陈凡的名号在柳溪镇低阶散修中传得更广了。
不少散修都知道镇西那个面色蜡黄的陈铁匠手艺扎实，连不入流的极品法器都能摸到门路。
一时间，陈凡摊位前的一阶中品、上品法器修补订单明显多了起来。
陈凡行事依旧低调，收费低廉，每次帮人修补飞剑或防御盾牌时，都会故意装作法力消耗过度、满头大汗的样子。
短短半个月时间，陈凡通过这门掩人耳目的手艺，除去材料成本，手里积攒的下品灵石竟然达到了四百多块。
眼下灵石足够，陈凡立刻通过周铁匠的渠道，开始搜寻更高级的炼器矿石。

两日后的深夜。
周氏铁匠铺的后院中，一盏油灯在石桌上摇晃。
周铁匠小心翼翼地从一个贴满了封灵符的铁盒子里，取出了一块拳头大小、通体散发着暗蓝色金属光泽的沉重矿石。
矿石出现的瞬间，院子里的温度隐隐下降了几分。
二阶低等矿石，玄金铁。
这是高阶炼器师用来打造二阶下品法器的常用主料之一，在这凡人聚集的柳溪镇，几乎是百年难得一见的稀罕货色。
“陈道友，为了这块玄金铁，老周我可是差点把黑市那条线给跑断了。”
周铁匠摸着下巴上的胡须，眼中满是肉痛，“大泽那边的黑市现在被血煞门盯得紧，放货的人开价极狠。整整三百块下品灵石，少一块都不行。道友要是吃不下，老周只能明天再退回去。”
三百下品灵石，对于一个正常的炼气八层散修来说是一笔巨大的数额。
陈凡没有任何犹豫，左手在储物袋上一拂，三堆下品灵石整整齐齐地码放在了石桌上，数量不多不少，正好三百块。
周铁匠呼吸一粗，连忙将灵石收入自己的储物袋，随后将那块沉甸甸的玄金铁推到了陈凡面前，嘿嘿低笑道：
“道友果然身家丰厚。看来你在集市上给人修补法器，赚的比老周我想象的还要多啊。”
陈凡不置可否地笑笑，将玄金铁收进储物袋，随即便告辞离去。
半刻钟后，镇西小院密室。
陈凡盘膝坐回石床，反手将四块一阶警戒阵盘全部催动，确认百丈之内没有任何修士的气息后，这才一拍储物袋。
content_en:
Chen Fan got up from the ground, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and the panic on his face was replaced by coldness.
He put the Bone Token into his storage bag, then closed his eyes, his mind sank into the sea of ​​Qi, and he began to search for clues about this person in the messy memory fragments of the ancestor of the Lin family.
After a hundred breaths, Chen Fan opened his eyes, a flash of realization flashed in his eyes.
"Linquan County old ghost."
Among the memory fragments of the ancestor of the Lin family, there was a secret jade slip about a master of casual cultivating in the Yun Kingdom, which recorded this person in detail.
This person is a well-known jack-of-all-trades in the world of Yun Kingdom's immortal cultivators. He specializes in intermediary of bulk materials, reselling of techniques and high-level intelligence transactions among high-level casual cultivators.
This person has no family or sect, but he has extremely wide connections and many methods.
The core information is that thirty years ago, this old ghost seemed to have stolen an incredible ancient artifact from an ancient ruins. He had an affair with a mysterious Nascent Soul stage monk in the human world and was hunted down all the way.
In order to avoid his enemies, he hid his appearance and traces of his cultivation, and fled to this chaotic place at the border of Linquan and Qingyang.
However, although this person looks greedy and slovenly, he has an excellent reputation in the black market in this border area. He specializes in benefits and promises, and never asks about the origin of his employer.
"Linquan County Ghost Market, a know-it-all... the enemy of the Yuanying monk."
After Chen Fan sorted out this information, he felt reassured.
Although the old ghost saw through one of his clues today, the other party left the bone token. Apparently he took a fancy to his weapon refining skills and wanted to develop him into a long-term partner of the ghost market in the future.
For Chen Fan, who is currently unable to move forward in Qingyang County, this is tantamount to laying an extremely important intelligence nail in Linquan County in advance.
In the next few days, due to Lao Gui's business, Chen Fan's name spread even more widely among the low-level casual cultivators in Liuxi Town.
Many casual cultivators know that the sallow-faced Blacksmith Chen in Zhenxi is very skilled in craftsmanship, and he can even find his way into the most inferior magical weapons.
Suddenly, there were obviously more repair orders for first-class mid-grade and high-grade magical instruments in front of Chen Fan's stall.
Chen Fan still acts in a low-key manner and charges low fees. Every time he helps others repair flying swords or defensive shields, he will deliberately pretend that he has exhausted too much mana and is sweating profusely.
In just half a month, through this deceptive craft, Chen Fan accumulated more than 400 low-grade spiritual stones after excluding the cost of materials.
Now that he had enough spirit stones, Chen Fan immediately started searching for higher-grade ore for refining through Blacksmith Zhou's channel.
Late at night two days later.
In the backyard of Zhou's blacksmith shop, an oil lamp swayed on the stone table.
Blacksmith Zhou carefully took out a fist-sized piece of heavy ore with a dark blue metallic sheen from an iron box covered with spirit-sealing talismans.
The moment the ore appeared, the temperature in the yard dropped slightly.
Second-order low-grade ore, black gold and iron.
This is one of the common ingredients used by high-level weapon refiners to create second-level low-grade magic weapons. In Liuxi Town, where mortals gather, it is a rare item that is rarely seen in a hundred years.
"Fellow Daoist Chen, Lao Zhou and I almost cut off the black market line for this piece of black gold iron."
Blacksmith Zhou touched the beard on his chin, his eyes full of pain, "The black market in Daze is now closely watched by the Blood Demon Sect, and the people who sell the goods are charging very harsh prices. A total of 300 yuan of low-grade spiritual stones, not even one less. If fellow Taoist can't eat it, Lao Zhou can only return it tomorrow."
Three hundred low-grade spiritual stones were a huge amount for a normal eighth-level Qi-refining casual cultivator.
Without any hesitation, Chen Fan flicked his left hand on the storage bag, and three piles of low-grade spiritual stones were neatly stacked on the stone table. The number was no more than no less, exactly three hundred yuan.
Blacksmith Zhou took a deep breath and quickly put the spirit stone into his storage bag. Then he pushed the heavy black gold iron in front of Chen Fan and chuckled:
"Fellow Taoist, you are indeed rich. It seems that you gave peopleRepairing magic weapons makes me earn more than I imagined, Lao Zhou. "
Chen Fan smiled noncommittally, put the Xuan Jin Tie into his storage bag, and then said goodbye and left.
Half a quarter of an hour later, in the secret room of Zhenxi courtyard.
Chen Fan sat cross-legged on the stone bed, activated all four first-level warning array disks with his backhand, and after confirming that there was no aura of monks within a hundred feet, he patted the storage bag.
